description: This file contains utility functions for handling node-related labels and warnings in Kubernetes, including deprecated label detection and warning generation for node selectors and runtime classes.

methods.name: GetNodeLabelDeprecatedMessage
methods.description: Returns a message and a boolean indicating if the provided label key is deprecated.

methods.name: GetWarningsForRuntimeClass
methods.description: Generates warnings if the RuntimeClass's node selector uses deprecated labels.

methods.name: GetWarningsForNodeSelector
methods.description: Checks if any node selector requirements use deprecated labels and returns warnings.

methods.name: GetWarningsForNodeSelectorTerm
methods.description: Checks match expressions within a node selector term for deprecated labels and invalid label values, returning warnings.
